Method of Attack: Insecure Over-the-Air (OTA) update system with unencrypted communications allowing Man-in-the-Middle attacks to send rogue commands with root privileges
Firmware OTA hides its presence from Android OS and runs as root, creating an open backdoor
Use of hard-coded OTA server domains to control devices remotely
Impacted Systems: Multiple smartphone models from BLU Products
Devices from Infinix Mobility, DOOGEE, LEAGOO, IKU Mobile, Beeline, XOLO
Attack Vector: Unencrypted OTA update communications channel allowing Man-in-the-Middle attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Three hard-coded OTA server domains (one tracked as CVE-2016-6564)
Presence of hidden OTA update binaries running as root
